title: Recast any performance
pitch: Design a character, shoot a scene, then put your character in the scene.
why: H3 Recast keeps the camera, the timing and the performance and changes who plays it. The output shows source and result together.

fields.label: Your character
fields.default: a fictional adult man with a thick red beard and wild red hair, wearing a dark blue sailor coat

models.name: MiniMax H3
models.note: Show the name in commercial products. Read the licence's territory terms before you rely on it.

models.name: ffmpeg
models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: Say who to replace by look and position.
About 9 minutes for the swap on this box.

steps.label: Recast
steps.model: MiniMax H3 with the swap LoRA

steps.label: Before and after
steps.what: Puts the versions next to each other with labels.

expected.basis: sum of each step's measured time on this box, with a cold start per step

raw_steps.label: Character
raw_steps.prompt: Full body photograph of {character}, standing, facing the camera, plain light grey studio background, soft even light. No text, no logos.

raw_steps.label: The scene
raw_steps.prompt: A chef in a white jacket in a dark kitchen flambes a pan, a tall column of golden fire lights her focused face, the camera pushes in slowly, sizzling sounds and a low flame roar, cinematic shallow depth of field.

raw_steps.label: Recast
raw_steps.target: the chef in the white jacket
